one_line_contribution: A transplant / difference-in-differences diagnostic (optimize instructions under memory-present vs. memory-absent regimes, then cross-evaluate under absent / same-bank / shifted-bank / truncated regimes) claiming that reflectively-optimized instructions silently absorb the specific memory bank they were tuned against, so that reported optimizer+memory gains are bank-conditional; plus a counterfactual-replay routing rule (CCR) that sends memory-caused failures to the bank rather than the instruction. The proposal explicitly concedes the counterfactual-replay signal itself is prior art, so the novel object is the diagnostic and the bank-conditionality claim, not the fix.
closest_prior_work: Two different works threaten the two halves. For the fix: CANTANTE (2605.13295) and UCOB (2606.29502) already do contrastive / two-view counterfactual credit attribution over context components, and the proposal itself demotes UCOB's mechanism to a baseline (B9); if B9 matches B6, CCR is a gradient-free reimplementation of published machinery and the method claim is gone by the proposal's own pre-commitment. Environment-Grounded APO (2606.17838) already runs failure-source attribution (context module vs. agent behavior) inside a prompt-optimization loop; the distinction offered — its Descriptor is a fixed perception module rather than a self-editing bank — is a difference in the object attributed over, not in the attribution method, and is thin for a main-track novelty argument. For the diagnostic, the real threat is not an agent-memory paper at all but the instruction-vs-exemplar decomposition line (MIPRO; 'Teach Better or Show Smarter?') combined with the ordinary, universally known fact that an artifact optimized under regime A is best under regime A. The transplant design is a standard train/test-regime-mismatch 2x2; calling its outcome 'co-adaptation' renames a familiar result unless the proposal can show the memory-specific DiD exceeds a generic regime-matching DiD, which it never attempts.
strongest_objection: P1 is close to unfalsifiable in the interesting direction, and P2's premise is contradicted by the track's own data. (a) The headline DiD = [acc(R_mem@T_mem) - acc(R_mem@T_nomem)] - [acc(R_nomem@T_mem) - acc(R_nomem@T_nomem)] is positive whenever optimization does anything at all, because each instruction is evaluated in the regime it was selected in. The plan contains no control that separates 'the instruction encoded compensations for Bank_A' from 'any optimized artifact degrades off its training regime.' The instruction-paraphrase control tests prompt fragility, not regime matching; the memory-referential-clause readout (P3) is a Spearman correlation over n=10 runs from a subjective judge — at rho=0.5, n=10, that is not distinguishable from chance and cannot carry the mechanistic burden. So a confirmed P1 is uninformative and a refuted P1 is the only outcome that teaches anything, which is the wrong way round for a paper whose primary claim is P1. (b) The research track's own measured starting position is that injecting the full bank at k=7 fixed zero items and broke six to seven. If that reproduces in E1, then acc(R_mem@T_mem) - acc(R_mem@T_nomem) is near zero or negative and there is no headline gain to be 'rented': P2, the sharp and disagreeable claim the proposal rests its significance on, becomes vacuous, and no gate anywhere in the plan detects this before the budget is spent. (c) P2 is operationalized as a ratio ('R_mem instructions drop at least twice as much'), and the denominator is R_nomem's T_mem-to-T_shift drop, which for an instruction that never mentions memory should be near zero — making the criterion either trivially satisfied or undefined. (d) The power arithmetic assumes a between-optimizer-seed SD of 2.0-2.5 points, but the track reports re-scoring/null-replicate drift of 5-14 points in this exact setting; if the larger figure is what the null optimizer replicate returns, the paired-seed MDE is roughly 8+ points, P5 (a 5-point reduction) is undetectable, and the pre-registered cut order does not rescue it because it cuts scope, not variance.
what_would_fix_it: Four concrete changes, all cheap relative to the 107k-episode budget. (1) Add a memory-irrelevant regime-shift control: optimize under R_mem and evaluate under a perturbation of comparable magnitude that has nothing to do with memory (step-limit change, tool-output formatting change, or a distractor-passage swap), and pre-register that the memory DiD must significantly exceed this generic regime-matching DiD. Without that floor, P1 measures overfitting-to-training-regime, which nobody disputes. (2) Add an explicit go/no-go gate before Part 2 and Part 3: on the unoptimized prompt, B1 minus B0 at T_mem must show memory conferring a positive gain of at least the stated MDE; if the track's zero-fix/six-break result reproduces, P2 is void and the paper should be rewritten as 'memory does not help, so there is nothing to co-adapt to' rather than reporting a rented-gain result with no rent. (3) Restate P2 as an absolute three-way interaction (regime x bank x seed) with a CI, not a ratio of drops, and report R_nomem's drop with its own CI. (4) Run the null optimizer replicate as a pilot and set the MDEs from the observed between-seed SD before committing the seed counts, instead of assuming 2.0-2.5 in the face of the cited 5-14 point drift. Additionally, the paper's motivating target (ACE-style joint offline prompt optimization plus online memory adaptation) is never actually run — B3 is a home-built composition with a frozen bank — so the claim that published gains are bank-conditional is not tested on any published system; either run one genuine joint loop or scope the claim to the reimplementation.
missing_baseline: Bank randomization during optimization: run the optimizer with memory always present but with the injected items drawn each minibatch from a rotating pool of banks (or a resampled subset of Bank_A), and/or perform candidate selection on validation minibatches that use a held-out bank. This is domain randomization applied to the demonstration slot, it is the first thing a competent engineer would try after reading the diagnostic, and it plausibly removes bank-conditionality without sacrificing any of the memory's contribution — which is exactly the outcome the proposal asserts only CCR can achieve (P6). B4 randomizes only presence/absence and B10 only volume; neither varies bank content, so neither covers this. A second omission: a retrieval-gating / abstention baseline where the agent decides per step whether to admit retrieved items — the track lists the injection budget as a first-class decision variable, and B10's fixed k=2 cap is a strawman version of it. A third, cheaper one: instructions optimized with memory but early-stopped or candidate-selected on T_shift-style validation.
preprint_collision: The check is unusually diligent on the axis that does not carry the novelty and empty on the axis that does — and the proposal says so itself, which is honest but is still a weakness, not a neutral. Ten-plus specific 2026 preprints are named and correctly triaged for the counterfactual-credit mechanism (HiMPO 2606.16285, CANTANTE 2605.13295, UCOB 2606.29502, Memory-R2 2605.21768, TreeMem 2605.04811, 2605.30227, Env-Grounded APO 2606.17838), and the author concedes the mechanism as prior art. But the single load-bearing novel move — a transplant / difference-in-differences evaluation of optimized prompts under memory ablation and bank substitution — was never searched: both sessions were rate-limited before the targeted queries ran. Two live residual risks are flagged and unresolved: 'Tracing and Attributing Errors in LLM Memory Systems' (2605.28732), retrieved at title level only, is a direct-sounding collision, and the ICLR 2026 counterfactual-RAG poster's abstract was never retrieved. Beyond what the author lists, the check never touches the adjacent literature most likely to have pre-empted the diagnostic: in-context-learning work on prompts overfitting to their exemplar set, and RAG work measuring a model's reliance on injected context versus its parametric behavior — both routinely report the exact cross-regime evaluation being proposed as the new object. Net: novelty on the fix is conceded away, and novelty on the diagnostic rests on a search that was not performed.
